<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.0691 Da. A formula that matches this exact mass within typical analytical tolerance is C₁₄H₁₀O₂ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 210.0681 Da). The observed M+2 isotope intensity (~12 % of the base peak) is consistent with the expected 13C contribution for a 14‑carbon molecule (≈15 %). Therefore the molecular formula is C14H10O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H10O2</final_answer>
